discrepancy_reconciliation.discrepancy: Some reports cite 3.461e9 MACs, others cite 3.991e9 MACs.
discrepancy_reconciliation.reconciliation: 3.461e9 (3,461,011,968) is exact mathematical Useful MACs. 3.991e9 (3,991,404,544) is Hardware Padded MACs due to 32x32 PE block granularity (1.153x padding overhead). Both are valid but denote distinct lower bounds.

discrepancy_reconciliation.discrepancy: Preliminary scripts cited 929,293,344 B (0.465s @ 2GB/s); Board counters show 933,028,896 B; Compulsory tensor footprint is only 102,055,936 B.
discrepancy_reconciliation.reconciliation: 929MB was an early approximation. 933MB (807.9MB vector/layout + 125.1MB matrix) is the exact measured hardware traffic of the unoptimized 68 plans. 0.465s is only valid under a serialized half-duplex channel. Furthermore, 933MB is NOT a mathematical minimum: true tensor lifetime analysis reveals compulsory on-chip data volume is 102MB (9.14x lower) and all-intermediate DDR volume is 127MB (7.33x lower).

discrepancy_reconciliation.discrepancy: Board case0000 takes 154.82s, while 68 closed plans take 12.49s.
discrepancy_reconciliation.reconciliation: 68 closed plans cover only the fused CONV/FFN kernels. The remaining 142.33s is dominated by unfused operators, CPU MMIO control loops, and boundary PCIe/network overhead. Acceleration of 68 plans alone cannot collapse whole case without full-graph PL migration.

discrepancy_reconciliation.discrepancy: 600 MHz compute target vs DS925 PS AXI maximum 333 MHz.
discrepancy_reconciliation.reconciliation: 600 MHz is strictly restricted to PL local systolic arrays and DSP datapaths. The PS-PL AXI interface cannot exceed 333 MHz (-2 speed grade) and currently runs at 125 MHz. Asynchronous FIFOs and CDC are mandatory.

discrepancy_reconciliation.topic: DDR Physical Peak vs HP Interface Peak
discrepancy_reconciliation.discrepancy: ps_properties shows DDR4 64-bit @ 800MHz (12.8 GB/s), but PL HP0 is only 2.0 GB/s.
discrepancy_reconciliation.reconciliation: The PS DDR controller achieves 12.8 GB/s physical peak. However, all 6 PL masters converge through SmartConnect into a single 128-bit HP0 port at 125 MHz, creating an artificial 2.0 GB/s bottleneck. PL masters do not get 6x2 GB/s.

actionable_priority_roadmap.impact: Eliminates host runtime polling, collapsing whole-case 142.3s overhead.

actionable_priority_roadmap.action: Multi-HP Port Expansion & Interface Frequency Boost
actionable_priority_roadmap.impact: Split 6 masters across HP0-HP3, increase interface clock from 125MHz to 250MHz (4.0 GB/s per port, up to 8-12 GB/s aggregate).
Reduces vector/layout DDR traffic from 807MB toward compulsory 102MB-127MB (up to 7x bandwidth reduction).
AMD recommended 128-bit 16-beat bursts; hides round-trip read latency, boosting bus utilization from 30% to >90%.
Provides 9.6 GB/s independent bandwidth if AXU15EG PL DDR4 is verified on hardware.
Scales matrix compute time down to 45ms (useful) / 52ms (padded).
